name: Club
content: The Club is a Simple Melee Weapon that deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage with a range of 5 feet and a weight of 2 pounds. It costs 1 sp and has the properties Light (Light) and Monk (Monk). This weapon is most effective in Melee combat situations, requiring strength and accuracy to wield effectively.

name: Handaxe
content: The Handaxe is a Simple Melee weapon that belongs to the Weapon equipment category, costing 5 gp and weighing 2 units. It has a damage dice of 1d6 slashing damage, with a range of 5 feet for normal attacks and 20 feet for throwing. The Handaxe has the properties of being Light, Thrown, and suitable for Monks. This versatile weapon is ideal for close combat situations, offering both melee and ranged capabilities.

name: Greatclub
content: The Greatclub is a Simple Melee weapon belonging to the Weapon equipment category. It is a Two-Handed weapon with a Melee range of 5 feet, costing 2 silver pieces and weighing 10 pounds. It inflicts 1d8 points of Bludgeoning damage upon impact. This weapon requires strength and proficiency in melee combat for effective use.

name: Dagger
content: The dagger is a Simple Melee weapon in the Weapon equipment category, with a Piercing damage type of 1d4. It weighs 1 gp and has a normal range of 5 feet, with the ability to be thrown up to 20 feet. The dagger has the properties of Finesse, Light, Thrown, and Monk, making it versatile for various combat situations. Its lightweight design and finesse allow for quick and precise attacks, ideal for skilled fighters.

name: Mace
content: The Mace is a Simple Melee weapon that deals 1d6 Bludgeoning damage at a range of 5 feet, costing 5 gp and weighing 4 pounds. It falls under the Weapon equipment category and has the Monk property.

name: Javelin
content: The Javelin is a Simple Melee weapon in the Weapon category, with a cost of 5 sp and a weight of 2. It inflicts Piercing damage with 1d6 damage dice and has a normal range of 5 feet. The Javelin can be Thrown up to 30 feet normally and up to 120 feet at long range. It also has the properties Thrown and Monk, making it suitable for characters proficient in Monk weapons.

name: Quarterstaff
content: The Quarterstaff is a Simple Melee weapon that belongs to the Weapon equipment category. It costs 2 silver pieces and weighs 4 pounds, with a normal range of 5 feet for Melee attacks. This versatile weapon deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage when wielded with one hand and 1d8 bludgeoning damage when used with two hands. The Quarterstaff is favored by Monks for its versatility and effectiveness in combat.

name: Light hammer
content: The Light Hammer is a Simple Melee weapon in the Weapon equipment category, costing 2 gp and weighing 2 pounds. It deals 1d4 Bludgeoning damage with a range of 5 feet, and has the properties of Light, Thrown, and Monk. The thrown range is 20/60 feet. This weapon is suitable for characters proficient in light weapons and those with a focus on agility and precision in combat.

name: Sickle
content: The sickle is a Simple Melee weapon that falls under the Weapon equipment category. It has a damage output of 1d4 slashing damage and a range of 5 feet, making it ideal for close combat. Weighing 2 pounds, it is a light weapon that can be wielded effectively by monks, showcasing its versatility in combat situations. The cost of a sickle is 1 gold piece, making it an affordable and practical choice for adventurers.

name: Spear
content: The Spear is a Simple Melee weapon in the Weapon category, with a range of 5 feet and a weight of 3 pounds. It costs 1 gp and deals 1d6 piercing damage. It has the properties of Thrown, Versatile, and Monk, allowing it to be thrown up to 20 feet or used with two hands for 1d8 piercing damage. This weapon is proficient in the Melee weapon category and is ideal for characters with proficiency in piercing damage.

name: Crossbow, light
content: The light crossbow is a simple ranged weapon that costs 25 gold pieces and weighs 5 pounds. It inflicts 1d8 piercing damage and has a normal range of 80 feet, with a long range of 320 feet. The light crossbow requires ammunition, has the loading property, and is two-handed. It falls under the Weapon equipment category and is associated with skills or attributes related to ranged combat.

name: Sling
content: The Sling is a Simple Ranged weapon from the Weapon equipment category, costing 1 sp with a damage of 1d4 Bludgeoning. It has a range of 30 feet normal and 120 feet long, with a weight of 0. The Sling has the Ammunition property, making it a versatile choice for ranged combat. Its simplicity and lightweight nature make it suitable for characters proficient in ranged weapons, offering a balance of accuracy and mobility in battles.

name: Battleaxe
content: The Battleaxe is a Martial Melee weapon that belongs to the Weapon equipment category. It costs 10 gold pieces and weighs 4 pounds, with a damage dice of 1d8 for slashing damage. It has a normal range of 5 feet and the versatile property, allowing it to be wielded with one or two hands for different damage dice (1d10 when wielded two-handed). This versatile weapon is ideal for characters proficient in martial weapons and looking for a versatile option in close combat situations.

name: Flail
content: The Flail is a Martial Melee weapon that costs 10 gp and weighs 2 pounds. It has a damage dice of 1d8, dealing Bludgeoning damage. The weapon has a range of 5 feet and belongs to the Weapon equipment category. This versatile weapon does not have any specific properties and requires proficiency in martial weapons to wield effectively.

It has a range of 80 feet (320 feet long), weighs 2 pounds, and has the properties Ammunition and Two-Handed. This weapon falls under the Weapon equipment category and is suitable for ranged combat scenarios, requiring skill in archery for effective use.

name: Glaive
content: The Glaive is a Martial Melee weapon that costs 20 gp and weighs 6 units. It deals 1d10 slashing damage with a normal range of 5 feet. This versatile weapon has the properties of Heavy, Reach, and Two-Handed, making it suitable for skilled wielders who value both reach and power in combat.

name: Greataxe
content: The Greataxe is a Martial Melee weapon that belongs to the Weapon equipment category. It costs 30 gold pieces and weighs 7 pounds. This two-handed weapon has a damage dice of 1d12 and deals Slashing damage. With a range of 5 feet, it is a heavy weapon that requires proficiency in using Two-Handed weapons.

content: The Greatsword is a Martial Melee weapon that costs 50 gp and weighs 6 units. It deals 2d6 Slashing damage and has a range of 5 feet. This weapon is categorized as Heavy and Two-Handed, requiring strength and proficiency in martial weapons to wield effectively.

name: Halberd
content: The Halberd is a Martial Melee weapon that costs 20 gp and weighs 6 pounds, with a damage output of 1d10 Slashing. It has a normal range of 5 feet and is characterized by the properties Heavy, Reach, and Two-Handed. This versatile weapon requires proficiency in martial weapons and strength to wield effectively.

name: Dart
content: The Dart is a Simple Ranged weapon that belongs in the Weapon equipment category. It has a cost of 5 copper pieces and deals 1d4 Piercing damage. The Dart has a range of 20 feet normal and 60 feet long, and weighs 0.25 pounds. It possesses the properties Finesse and Thrown, allowing for precise and long-range attacks. This weapon is ideal for characters proficient in finesse weapons and those skilled in ranged combat.

name: Maul
content: Maul is a Martial Melee weapon in the Weapon equipment category, costing 10 gp and weighing 10 units. It inflicts damage with 2d6 bludgeoning dice and has a normal range of 5 feet. Maul is classified as Heavy and Two-Handed, requiring strength and proficiency in martial weapons to wield effectively.

special: You have disadvantage when you use a lance to attack a target within 5 feet of you. Also, a lance requires two hands to wield when you aren't mounted.
content: The Lance is a Martial Melee weapon in the Weapon category, costing 10 gold pieces and weighing 6 pounds. It deals Piercing damage with a 1d12 damage dice and has a normal range of 5 feet. The Lance has the Reach and Special properties, allowing for attacks with disadvantage within 5 feet and requiring two hands when not mounted.

name: Rapier
content: The Rapier is a Martial Melee weapon belonging to the Weapon equipment category. It costs 25 gold pieces and has a weight of 2 pounds. The Rapier is known for its precision and agility in combat, making it a favored weapon among those who value speed and finesse over sheer brute force.

A versatile weapon suitable for agile fighters, the Scimitar is ideal for those skilled in finesse-based combat techniques.

name: Shortsword
content: The Shortsword is a Martial Melee weapon that costs 10 gp and weighs 2 units. It inflicts 1d6 Piercing damage with a normal range of 5 feet. It has the properties Finesse (FNS), Light (LGT), and Monk (MNK), allowing for versatile combat styles. The finesse property enables the use of Dexterity for attack and damage rolls, while the light property allows for dual-wielding or quick strikes. Monks can wield this weapon proficiently, emphasizing agility and precision in combat.

name: Trident
content: The Trident is a Martial Melee weapon that costs 5 gp, weighs 4 lbs, and has a normal range of 5 feet. It inflicts 1d6 Slashing damage and has the Thrown and Versatile properties. content: The War pick is a Martial Melee weapon belonging to the Weapon category. It costs 5 gp and weighs 2 units. The damage dealt by this weapon is 1d8 Piercing damage, with a range of 5 feet. This weapon has no additional properties.

name: Warhammer
content: The Warhammer is a Martial Melee weapon that costs 15 gp and weighs 2 units. content: The heavy crossbow is a Martial Ranged weapon that costs 50 gp and weighs 18 pounds. It deals 1d10 Piercing damage with a range of 100/400 feet. This weapon has the properties of Ammunition, Heavy, Loading, and Two-Handed, requiring strength and precision to wield effectively.

name: Whip
content: The Whip is a Martial Melee weapon that belongs to the Weapon equipment category. It has a cost of 2 gp, deals 1d4 slashing damage, and has a normal range of 5 feet. content: Padded Armor is a light armor that provides an armor class of 11 base with the ability to add a dexterity bonus. It has a weight of 8 pounds and costs 5 gold pieces to purchase. While wearing Padded Armor, you will have disadvantage on stealth checks due to the noise it creates. There is no strength minimum required to wear this armor, making it a versatile choice for those who prioritize mobility and stealth in their adventures.

name: Longbow
content: The Longbow is a Martial Ranged weapon that costs 50 gp and deals 1d8 Piercing damage. It has a range of 150/600 feet and weighs 2 pounds. The Longbow requires Ammunition, is Heavy, and is Two-Handed.

content: Leather Armor is a light Armor that provides an armor class base of 11 with a dexterity bonus. It has a strength minimum of 0 and does not impose disadvantage on stealth. Weighing 10 pounds, it costs 10 gold pieces. The leather armor falls under the equipment category of Armor and can be found at the url "/api/equipment/leather-armor".

name: Net
special: A Large or smaller creature hit by a net is restrained until it is freed. A net has no effect on creatures that are formless, or creatures that are Huge or larger. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming it, ending the effect and destroying the net. When you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to attack with a net, you can make only one attack regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.
content: The Net is a Martial Ranged weapon that costs 1 gp and weighs 3 units. It has a normal range of 5 feet and a long range of 15 feet. The Net has the Thrown property, allowing it to be thrown as a ranged weapon. When a Large or smaller creature is hit by the net, it becomes restrained until freed. The net has no effect on formless creatures or Huge or larger creatures. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check to free itself or another creature within reach. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net also frees the creature without harm. When attacking with a net, only one attack can be made per action, bonus action, or reaction.

name: Alchemist's fire (flask)
desc: This sticky, adhesive fluid ignites when exposed to air.
As an action, you can throw this flask up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the alchemist's fire as an improvised weapon.
On a hit, the target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can end this damage by using its action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.
content: Alchemist's fire (flask) is a type of Adventuring Gear found in the Standard Gear category. It costs 50 gp and weighs 1 unit. This sticky, adhesive fluid ignites upon exposure to air and can be thrown up to 20 feet as an improvised weapon, dealing 1d4 fire damage on a hit. The target continues to take fire damage at the start of each turn unless they succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.

On a hit, the target takes 2d6 acid damage.
content: Acid (vial) is a type of Adventuring Gear in the Standard Gear category, costing 25 gp and weighing 1 unit. Appendix B lists the symbols commonly associated with many gods in the multiverse. A cleric or paladin can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus. To use the symbol in this way, the caster must hold it in hand, wear it visibly, or bear it on a shield.
content: Amulet is an item under the Adventuring Gear (AG) category and specifically falls under the Holy Symbols (HS) gear category. It costs 5 gold pieces (gp) and weighs 1 unit. name: Ball bearings (bag of 1,000)
desc: As an action, you can spill these tiny metal balls from their pouch to cover a level, square area that is 10 feet on a side.
A creature moving across the covered area must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.
A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the save.
content: Ball bearings (bag of 1,000) are categorized under Adventuring Gear (AG) and fall under the Standard Gear (SG) category. They cost 1 gold piece (gp) and weigh 2 units. When spilled, these metal balls cover a 10-foot square area, causing creatures to make a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw to avoid falling prone. Moving at half speed negates the need for the save. These items are useful for creating obstacles and hindering movement in tactical situations.

desc: As an action, you can spread a bag of caltrops to cover a square area that is 5 feet on a side.
Any creature that enters the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or stop moving this turn and take 1 piercing damage.
Taking this damage reduces the creature's walking speed by 10 feet until the creature regains at least 1 hit point.
A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the save.
content: Caltrops are a type of Adventuring Gear that falls under the Standard Gear category, costing 5 copper pieces and weighing 2 pounds. When used, a bag of caltrops can cover a 5-foot square area, requiring creatures entering to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or suffer 1 piercing damage and have their walking speed reduced by 10 feet until they regain at least 1 hit point. Creatures moving at half speed are exempt from the saving throw.
